executionPolicy.antiLoopRule: Reject work unless it verifies a missing exit criterion, removes a named completion blocker, or safely advances beyond a deferred true human gate.
executionPolicy.waveSuccessRule: A wave is productive only if it verifies an exit criterion, clears a gate, integrates an exact-SHA candidate, emits a receipt, closes a macrocycle, or advances the execution cursor past a true human gate.
executionPolicy.blockedProjectRule: A true human gate blocks only its exact sensitive action and strictly dependent work; it is persisted to pendingHumanGates and never stops the project scheduler or other enabled projects.
executionPolicy.fanOutRule: Dispatch closure work independently for every enabled project and continue safe work even when one or more human gates are pending.

completed.title: Modalità rapide, casa, viaggio e attrezzatura

active.title: Collaudo end-to-end e performance
active.outcome: Realistic full journeys pass exact-SHA reliability and performance gates.

exitCriteria.description: A realistic authenticated cumulative journey from profile and assessment through planning, session execution, feedback, wearable/image evidence, adaptation and history passes against durable canonical state without browser-local or query-only shortcuts.

Reliability and performance remain bounded under repeated sessions, long histories, retries and restart/recovery; latency or resource-limit failures are explicit and do not corrupt or silently drop durable state.
End-to-end replay is deterministic and preserves authorization, privacy lifecycle, causal/version provenance and exactly-once history without duplicate sessions or divergent recommendations.
Product CI, independent review, realistic cumulative end-to-end Robot and performance journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

active.title: Laboratorio galenico e materie prime
active.outcome: Formulas, preparations, lots, labels and consumption are fully managed.

exitCriteria.description: Canonical formulas, raw materials, preparations and laboratory operators persist validated identities, composition/version metadata and attributable lifecycle state.
Raw-material lots, expiry, quantities and preparation consumption are validated and posted atomically and exactly once, with traceable provenance from input lots to finished preparation.
Preparation validation, labels and quantity calculations fail closed on missing, expired, conflicting or unsafe source data and corrections preserve the original audit trail.
Operators can create, reopen, search and export formula/preparation records and labels with explicit draft/prepared/released/exception states using durable data.
Product CI, independent review, PFarma galenic-laboratory Robot plus required cumulative simulation, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

completed.title: Ricerca, filtri, duplicati e qualità archivio

active.title: Memorie, ricorrenze e prodotti derivati
active.outcome: Derived memory journeys are generated from real persistent media.

exitCriteria.description: Authorized family members generate derived memories and recurrence candidates only from durable canonical media and metadata within their family scope, never from browser-local or inaccessible records.
Recurrence grouping, ordering and regeneration are deterministic and idempotent across restart, equal timestamps, new uploads and repeated generation without duplicate derived identities.
Derived products preserve exact source provenance and react safely to source deletion, restoration, privacy or metadata changes by invalidating or recomputing without silent stale content.
Family members can browse and open derived memories with explicit partial, unavailable and regeneration states while preserving authorization and canonical media navigation.
Product CI, independent review, realistic memory/recurrence/derived-product Robot journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

transitionRule: Certified completion activates the next macrocycle immediately. A true human gate keeps its macrocycle OPEN as DEFERRED_HUMAN_GATE in pendingHumanGates but also advances the execution cursor so autonomous independent work never stops.
reconciliationRule: Before every wave, replace stale PR, SHA, integration, completion and human-gate fields using live GitHub evidence and commit ancestry; revisit pending human gates on every trigger.
